Peleng, Banggai Islands Regency, Central Sulawesi, Indonesia

paras: The Banggai jungle flycatcher (Cyornis pelingensis) is a species of passerine bird in the Old World flycatcher family Muscicapidae.
It is endemic to Peleng in Indonesia where its natural habitat is subtropical or tropical moist lowland forests.
